name: one-shot-bench
description: one-shot-bench evaluates language models' ability to generalize from a single example (one-shot) across a variety of tasks. It measures how well models can perform new tasks given minimal in-context demonstration, covering both reasoning and knowledge-intensive prompts. The benchmark is used to compare few-shot generalization capabilities across models and prompting strategies.
reputation: A community resource used by researchers studying few-shot and in-context learning, with moderate visibility in the ML evaluation community.
